LESSON: LANGUAGE USE 10.3.1 SIMPLE PREPOSITIONS (IN, ON, UNDER, BETWEEN, BEHIND, IN FRONT, INSIDE, OUTSIDE)

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade one
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.3: Language use 10.3.1 Simple prepositions (in, on, under, between, behind, in front, inside, outside)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language use 10.3.1 Simple prepositions (in, on, under, between, behind, in front, inside, outside), part of Strand 10 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade one General.

Key inquiry question: where the objects are on the flash cards using the words: in, on, under, between, behind, in front, inside, outside, for example, where is the fire engine?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language use 10.3.1 Simple prepositions (in, on, under, between, behind, in front, inside, outside) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Digital Literacy: Interacts with technology as they play digital games based on prepositions.

Values:
• Unity: cooperation is developed as learners collaborate and take up roles in assigned games.

• Social justice: fairness is enhanced as learners accord each other equal opportunities in sharing roles.
